annotations.title: Prices of one product by barcode

description: Gives one product's price at each Israeli supermarket chain's online store, by its barcode: the price per chain, the cheapest chain, the gap between cheapest and dearest, the date of the prices and the product's page on Ramzii. Example barcode: "7290000066318".

barcode.description: The product's barcode (6 to 14 digits), e.g. "7290000066318".

name: product_prices

data_date.description: Israeli day (YYYY-MM-DD) of the oldest price in the answer.

open_url.description: A www.ramzii.co.il link that opens this answer.

title: Prices of one product by barcode
